posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The error means that something that has a property named "ratio" is currently not defined despite being needed.
This usually is a configuration problem - when changing the mentioned soundeffect you must have made an error that broke the configuration.
Unfortunately this plugin is probably old, because it still uses the script-editing type of configuration from pre-MV times. The entire plugin API was introduced to prevent editing inside the code, due to many cases where people edited the wrong comma or deleted the wrong empty line that were all needed for the correct function.
you basically need to check and compare your own configuration file with the original file to see if there is anything missing - which is difficult for someone without programming knowledge.
Knowing where you edited last can help, but it will still be a search for you.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
there are a few other possibilities, but they are unlikely in my opinion. For example it doesn't look like that plugin uses notetags, otherwise it could be a typo in a notetag you added.
and you need to be carefull in the editing - not knowing what went wrong also means there is a risc of repeating the error if it wasn't a simple wrong delete.
and as a comment to redownloading: whenever you edit some code, you should keep a backup of the original. And if there are a lot of edits, check often if it still works and keep an additional backup of the working versions until everything is entered and tested.
